text: Did you know that having dogs and cats in your house is one of the most powerful protections that exist? Before something bad enters your home, your animals already know it.

What for you is a bark at nothing, for your dog is a defence against what you cannot see. It gets alert. It stands between you and the door. It growls at empty corners. It is not crazy. It is working. Your cat does the opposite, and it is equally powerful. It does not fight. It absorbs.

It sits exactly where the air feels heaviest, and stares at places that for you are empty. When it curls up on your chest, it is cleaning what you carry. In our monastery we always kept both. The dog guards the entrance.

The cat clears what has entered. They are not simple pets. Respect them. Thank them. But your animals protect you from what comes from outside. What wounds most people lives inside, in the mind. That is the territory I teach.
Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
